# Head-to-head: Phrase vs plain C# on the frozen bar
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #88, sha256:6175476f9795b60e152b92c74c2e1edf5204bf9b19b1f3d21f75c795bec7c82b). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Ready (rank: see `C:\Users\ringe\projects\phrase-lang\board\MILESTONE-usable-v1.md`, read-only)
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** feature (thin slice; a measurement)
- **Milestone:** Measure first: does Phrase beat plain C# on tokens and attempts at an equal or better pass rate?
- **Source:** Steve's priority ruling, 2026-10-26 (an outside assessment of what Phrase is worth): the question that decides everything is whether models finish real tasks with fewer tokens and attempts in Phrase than in plain C# using the same libraries, at an equal or better pass rate; nothing has measured that yet. Team plan: Decider D31 (Codex, Copilot, Grok Support-it; agy no response). Pre-registered bar: Decider D32, recorded BEFORE any result row.
- **Depends on:** 085, 086, 087, 037
- **Story:** As Steve, I want one page that judges Phrase against plain C# on the frozen bar, so that I can decide whether vocabulary work continues.
- **Hypothesis (pre-registered):** We believe Phrase, once orders.phrase compiles, will meet the frozen bar for Ari. We will know when the page states WIN, LOSS, TIE or INCONCLUSIVE from the frozen numbers, with the patch rate and the holdout beside the token result. Frozen bar (Decider D32, amended after the seats' changes, recorded BEFORE any result): N = 5 SCHEDULED runs per model per task (harness-error rows stay in the count); attempt cap 3 (a run that never passes counts as 3 attempts and a fail); EVERY run is scored and a failed run is charged the tokens it consumed through attempt 3; means are task-macro averages (each task weighs the same); pass rate is the unweighted mean of per-model rates; pass rate: Phrase within 5 points of plain C# or better is WIN-eligible, 5 to 10 points worse is a TIE, worse than 10 points is a LOSS, and a read-task gap worse than 10 points blocks WIN; Phrase mean total tokens (documentation and cheat-sheet tokens INCLUDED, charged on every attempt) at most 75 percent of C# on tasks passing in both arms, on write tasks AND, separately, on change tasks; Phrase mean attempts at most the C# mean on each of those groups; patch rate 0: a run that goes green only by editing the generated C# counts as a Phrase fail and any patch share above 0 blocks WIN; fewer than 3 models, fewer than 3 paired task-runs in a group, or more than 10 percent harness-error rows makes the call INCONCLUSIVE; a write-only saving is a TIE; the holdout (3 tasks written outside the mob: one write, one change, one that fits no pattern; hashes recorded before the first scored run) is judged on the same bar and a holdout that is INCONCLUSIVE makes the whole call INCONCLUSIVE; the result is exactly one of WIN, LOSS, TIE, INCONCLUSIVE with absolute pass rates beside it. Frozen with the bar: model versions, prompts, context limits, task hashes, timeouts, token accounting and the retry policy. Little-room gate: if every included model is at 90 percent pass rate or more and 2 mean attempts or fewer on plain C#, and change-task tokens are at most 2 times write-task tokens, the emitter chain pauses for one Decider. A later change to any number is a new Decider and voids stored rows.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given the development tasks plus the three sealed holdouts, run cold at N=5, When the page is written, Then it reports pass rate, attempts and total tokens for write and for change tasks, and the Phrase totals include the documentation and cheat-sheet tokens (the check fails if change tasks are missing)
  2. Given a Phrase attempt-loop repair, When the row is stored, Then it records an edit to the Phrase source or to the generated C#; a pass that only edits generated C# counts as a Phrase fail, and the page applies the 10 percent patch-rate cap and the context tokens needed to change existing code
  3. Given the frozen numbers, When the page is read, Then it states exactly one of WIN, LOSS, TIE or INCONCLUSIVE (the check fails if any frozen number was changed after the first 086 row)
